reason: All named characters in this text hold positions of significant authority or status: Zedekiah (king), Nebuchadnezzar (king), Hamital (queen mother), Nebuzaradan (captain of the guard), Seraiah (chief priest), Zephaniah (second priest), Gedaliah (governor), Ishmael (of royal seed), Johanan (military officer), and others who are priests, commanders, or governmental officials. While the text references 'the people of the land' and common citizens collectively (עַם הָאָרֶץ), no individual of such ordinary status is given a name and developed as a character.
